items.title: Chico Hamilton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: MR. KIMERY is identified as a separate speaker (likely the interviewer or a co-interviewer) who speaks in the first person ('I know Devra', 'I'll get to him'). The interviewee (Chico Hamilton) does not mention Ken Kimery by name nor describe any personal or professional relationship with him in the

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. That was a shock. I mean that was a shock. That was a surprise, man. Devrea, goddamn. I saw them out in LA -- I mean Long Beach, right. Yeah, they were there. MR. KIMERY: (Unintelligible).
Well let’s go back to that first recording sessions. Were you nervous? Whenever a musician makes their first recording it’s usually pretty memorable.
